_comment: Photon Table, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over PhotonTableViewModel (gui/model.py): 'file' is the left window (open, copy, the file summary), 'photons' the right one (navigation, page fields, channel filter, the table of photons). Help and Guide are drawn by gui/app.py.
title: Photon Table

sections.title: TTTR file
sections.name: file
sections.description: The TTTR file and what it holds.
Open a TTTR file, or copy the rows shown now.

buttons.label: Open TTTR...
buttons.description: Open a TTTR file (.ptu, .ht3, .phu, ...). Dropping one on the window does the same.

buttons.label: Copy visible
buttons.description: Copy the visible rows to the clipboard as tab-separated text.

sections.text: Open a TTTR file, or drop one on this window, to inspect its photons.
sections.description: Shown until a file is loaded.
The file whose photons are listed.
How many photons the file holds, how long the measurement lasted (the last macro-time times the header's resolution) and how many micro-time channels the header declares.
The routing channels that occur in the file.
What was loaded, why a file could not be opened, or what was copied.

sections.title: Photons
sections.name: photons
sections.description: The photons of the file, one row each, a page at a time.
Move through the photons of the filtered selection a page at a time.

buttons.label: First
buttons.description: Jump to the first photon of the filtered selection.

buttons.label: Last
buttons.description: Jump to the last full page of the filtered selection.

sections.description: Which photons of the filtered selection the table shows now.

sections.label: First photon
sections.description: Index of the first photon shown, counted within the filtered selection. A value past the end is moved back so that the page stays full.

sections.label: Rows
sections.description: Rows shown at once (1 to 20000). Large pages are fine; the table only draws what fits the window.

sections.label: Channel
sections.description: Show only the photons of one routing channel. 'All channels' keeps the file's order. Choosing a channel goes back to its first photon.

One row per photon of the page. Photon is the index among the filtered photons, File idx the index in the file. Click a header to sort the page, click again to reverse; right click a header to choose columns.

columns.title: Photon
columns.tooltip: The photon's index among the filtered photons: the row number a script would address.

columns.title: File idx
columns.tooltip: The photon's index in the raw file.

columns.title: Channel
columns.tooltip: The routing channel (detector) of the photon.

columns.title: Micro time
columns.tooltip: The micro time: TCSPC channel of the photon after the laser pulse.

columns.title: Macro time [ms]
columns.tooltip: The macro time in milliseconds (macro-time units times the header's resolution; raw units when the resolution is unknown).
